source.projection_and_baryon_constraint: PDF10 printed5 eq1.24 and adjacent text

physical_scope.nuclide_definition: Each nuclear isotope reservoir is distinct from its atomic charge states.
physical_scope.large_donor_other51: Absent from D small-network model; not measured zero and not covariance constrained by D.

postprocessing.input: Existing successful native sample rows and covariance only; no new BBN solve.
postprocessing.native8: Retain all eight isotope samples and full joint sample covariance, ddof=1.
postprocessing.core7: Select first seven native isotope reservoirs without renormalization; preserve covariance with Be7.

bare_lift.interpretation: A fixed hypothetical charge assignment at the nuclear endpoint used only to expose the exact17 selector and conservation algebra. PRIMAT does not compute P_Aqalpha.
bare_lift.auxiliary_mapping: Be7 remains a separate reservoir; no endpoint electron-capture depletion or lithium daughter assignment is imposed.
bare_lift.linear_map: L is18x8. Nonzero core rows are the dictionary selector; L[17,7]=7. Use Z_s=L*Y_s and C_Z=L*C_Y*L^T.
bare_lift.zero_variance_slots: Expected structural zeros; covariance zero, correlation undefined/null. Do not add jitter and do not apply the base six-selected-observable positivity/variance gate to zero charge slots.

baryon_invariants.exact_constraint: For exactly conserved full samples, A^T*C_Y*A=0 and Cov(b,Y_i)=0; 18-state augmented weights are [A17,1].
finite_output_diagnostics: ddof1 variance and standard deviation of b_s
A^T*C_Y*A evaluated together with noncancelling centered-row variance
core17 weighted sum plus B_R residual
baryon_invariants.tolerance_reason: Ten times frozen1e-7 ODE precision is a loose postprocessing normalization screen, not a rigorous global solver error bound. Native exported10-significant-digit rounding must be reported. Actual residuals remain the scientific evidence.
baryon_invariants.roundoff_treatment: A^T*C*A can have cancellation error; retain its signed value and compare with nonnegative variance from centered baryon residuals. Never set an observed variance to zero by fiat.
baryon_invariants.transform_test: For nonzero-variance transformed slots, compare direct sample covariance with L*C_Y*L^T in standardized units<=1e-12. For structural zeros require exact zero rows/columns. Compare row partition at absolute<=1e-14.

postprocessing.general_atomic_state: If supplied P_Aqalpha is deterministic, y17=M(P)*Y and C17=M*C_Y*M^T; if P is uncertain or depends on the same physical parameters, joint derivatives/samples including that dependence are required. No independent invented P prior.

execution_changes.implementation_scope: Existing code/laneD postprocessing and evidence/nuclear_prior_* plus NUCLEAR_PRIOR_RESULT.json only

claim_boundaries: All actual donor59 nuclides are inventoried; only D small8 have new native joint covariance.
The conditional17 lift is not late-time chemistry, recombination or a physical charge-distribution solution.
No D covariance is attached to the old large-network donor.
No missing-isotope, atomic-model, astrophysical-source or EFT-truncation variance is assigned.
Full shared-parameter covariance across later rates and observables remains a subsequent calculation.
stopping_rule: Apply this algebraic postprocessing once to the existing successful ensemble; preserve outcomes and send to independent review. No extra Monte Carlo or process loop.
